notes: Implemented Phase 2 of mobile bottom sheet redesign via TDD. Added 15 new unit tests to BottomSheetTest.html (arrow key cycling, swipe-to-dismiss, body scroll lock, touchcancel cleanup, closed-sheet guard) and 3 CSS validation tests to ResponsiveCSSValidationTest.html (no-scroll class, no touch-action: none, prefers-reduced-motion for bottom sheet). World-review identified 7 issues: scroll position caching bug (fixed by always capturing current scrollTop), touch-action: none breaking canvas interactions (removed), arrow keys active when sheet closed (added guard), touchcancel cleanup (added _bsTouchCancel), fixed swipe threshold (made responsive: Math.max(60, window.innerHeight * 0.08)), document.body safety (added optional chaining), and device rotation scroll lock (deferred as low priority). All 146+ tests pass across all test files. No learnings worth documenting — all patterns (touchcancel cleanup, responsive swipe threshold, optional chaining for DOM safety) are standard practices already covered in existing skills.
